description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to appoint Mr. Upali de Soysa as Chairman and other Members to the Board of Reviews under the land Acquisition, w.e.f. 23.05.2017
categorisation: This gazette contains appointments to the Board of Review (a quasi-judicial body) under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically naming individuals as Lawyer Members and Valuer Members, including a Chairman and Vice Chairman. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it involves appointments to a legal review board that hears appeals related to land acquisition cases.
